name: 复古招贴
description: 强轮廓、大色块与温润专色结合，细微印刷颗粒带来经典招贴气质。
rendering_prompt: Use the graphic language of twentieth-century vintage posters, distilling the subject into strong contours, broad color blocks, and clearly divided light and dark regions. Establish a striking hierarchy and visual center through a limited palette of vintage spot colors. Keep tones rich without excessive vividness. Add subtle screen-print grain, paper texture, and uneven ink coverage, letting concise, forceful shapes carry the poster aesthetic.
avoid: 自动添加标题、照片质感、过多装饰
difference: 复古招贴是广义印刷语言；复古未来海报强调原子时代的流线未来感
tuning: 先做单幅主视觉与清晰层级，只有用户要求时加入文字。
